acts.title: The Awakening
acts.purpose: Introduce the world, establish the player's role, and hint at the core conflict.

story_beats.description: The player experiences a strange event that changes their fate.
The player must choose an allegiance or path that shapes their journey.

acts.title: The Rising Conflict
acts.purpose: Escalate tension, introduce factions, and deepen the mystery.

story_beats.description: A revelation changes what the player thought they knew.

acts.title: The Climax
acts.purpose: Resolve the main conflict and deliver player agency in the conclusion.

story_beats.description: The player faces the ultimate decision that determines the fate of the world.
